    sieve = [True] * (limit + 1)

        if sieve[start]:

    if n < 6:

\[ V(r) = 4 \epsilon \left[ \left( \frac{\sigma}{r} \right)^{12} - \left( \frac{\sigma}{r} \right)^6 \right] \]

where \( r \) is the distance between two particles, \( \epsilon \) is the energy constant (6.869e-3 Joule), and \( \sigma \) is the distance constant (S Angstrom).
